title: Polished marble found at the crash site

tellings.quote: But in 1999, the Ramsies did actually find something. what looks like a little polished marble, totally out of place.

plain: Some people say a flying saucer crashed in Hart Canyon, near the town of Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1999 a couple who searched the site, Scott and Suzanne Ramsay, found what looked like a small polished marble that seemed out of place there. If true, it would be a physical leftover from the crash.
